Terms.intro: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") govern the use of SpliTrip (the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
Terms.s1Body: The Service is a web application that helps users record group trip expenses, calculate how to split them, and share who should pay whom.
Terms.s2Body: Users may sign in with a Google account, a LINE account, or as a guest. When signing in through social login, the Service retrieves your public profile information (display name and profile picture) solely to set your display name and avatar within the Service.
s3Items: Interfering with the normal operation of the Service
Infringing the rights of other users
Violating any applicable law or regulation
Reverse-engineering, decompiling, or otherwise attempting to extract the source code of the Service
Terms.s4Body: The Service is a tool for recording and splitting expenses; it does not mediate, facilitate, or guarantee any actual monetary transfers between users. The operator assumes no liability whatsoever for financial disputes between users, or for any issues arising from the use of third-party payment services.
Terms.s5Body: The receipt scanning feature uses the Google Gemini API. Images uploaded by users are sent to Google's servers solely for data extraction purposes and are NOT used to train AI models. The Service does not store uploaded images on its own servers; images are discarded after analysis.
Terms.s6Body: When using the Service in guest mode, data is tied to the browser session. Data may be lost if the browser is closed or cookies/cache are cleared. The operator assumes no responsibility for data recovery in guest mode.
Terms.s7Body: The operator may modify, suspend, or terminate the Service at any time without prior notice. The operator is not liable for any disadvantage or damage caused to users as a result.
Terms.s8Body: All intellectual property rights related to the Service belong to the operator. Copyright of user-submitted data remains with the user, but the operator may use such data to the extent necessary for providing the Service.
Terms.s9Body: The operator may update these Terms as needed. Material changes will be communicated through the Service. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
Terms.s10Body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Japan. Any disputes arising from these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Tokyo District Court.

Privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how SpliTrip (the "Service") collects, uses, and protects user information.
s1Items: Public profile information obtained through social login (Google / LINE): display name, profile picture URL, email address
User-provided display name and payment handles (PayPal.me ID, Cash App Cashtag)
Group data, expense records, split and settlement data
Images temporarily uploaded for the receipt scanning feature
s2Items: To provide, operate, and improve the Service
To identify users and display their profiles
To share display names and avatars within groups
To display payment links in settlement plans
To extract expense data from receipt images
Privacy.s3Body: When you sign in with Google, we retrieve your Google public profile (display name, profile picture, email address). When you sign in with LINE, we retrieve your LINE public profile (display name, profile picture). This information is used solely for user identification and initializing your display name and avatar within the Service. We do not share this information with third parties.
Privacy.s4Body: When using the receipt scanning feature, uploaded images are sent to the Google Gemini API. Images are processed solely for data extraction (recognizing amounts, store names, and dates) and are NOT used to train Google's AI models. The Service does not store image data on its own servers.
Privacy.s5Body: In guest mode, account information is tied to the browser session. Data may be lost if the browser is closed or the cache is cleared. The operator does not guarantee data persistence for guest mode and is not responsible for recovering lost data.
Privacy.s6Body: User data is stored on Supabase, a cloud database service. All communications are encrypted via HTTPS, and database access is controlled through Row Level Security (RLS).
Privacy.s7Body: The operator does not share users' personal information with third parties except as required by law. However, data is transmitted to the following services as necessary for operating the Service:
s7Items: Google OAuth / LINE Login (social login authentication)
Privacy.s8Body: The Service uses cookies to maintain authentication sessions and to store language preferences.
Privacy.s9Body: Users may view, update, or delete their data from the Settings page. If you wish to delete your account entirely, please contact the operator.
Privacy.s10Body: This policy may be updated as necessary. Material changes will be communicated through the Service.
Privacy.s11Body: For questions about this policy, please contact the operator of the Service.

Commerce.intro: This page provides the required commercial disclosure for paid plans (SpliTrip PRO), including key billing terms for Stripe payments.
values: Tax-inclusive pricing is shown on each plan purchase page.
Internet connection and communication fees are borne by the customer.
Credit cards and other methods supported by Stripe. Billing timing follows the conditions shown on the checkout page.
PRO features are typically activated immediately after successful payment.
Due to the nature of digital services, returns are not accepted after delivery. Cancellation can be completed before the next renewal via Stripe Customer Portal.
A modern browser (Chrome / Safari / Edge / Firefox) and internet connection are required.
Settlement suggestions are generated from user-provided data and do not guarantee transfer outcomes.

Pitch.metaDescription: A scroll-snap deck highlighting what SpliTrip already ships for group trip splitting.
Pitch.heroTagline: Trip expenses split fairly—with fewer transfers.
Pitch.featureSettlementBody: We add up what everyone paid and owed, match people who owe with people who are owed, and shrink the number of transfers.
Pitch.featureSplitsBody: Equal splits, exact amounts, share weights, percentages, and line items—with fair handling of leftover cents in each currency.
Pitch.featureReceiptBody: Gemini reads amount, merchant, and date from a photo or file to pre-fill the form; receipts can live in Storage for later review in the detail dialog.
